text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, cute. It feels great to the touch too,
they must've used some pretty high-quality fabric.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
The stitching on these clothes is solid, too,
and there's real respect for the motif, right?
choice_data_list: That's such a nicely made plushie, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Really. When you actually touch it, you can feel it even more.
The feelings of the people who made it, or rather,
their expectations...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Alright, guess I'd better work harder too.
